title: clerodendrum linifolium
intro: Clerodendrum linifolium, commonly known as the Narrow-leaf Glory Bower, is a flowering plant native to tropical Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Clerodendrum linifolium include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral activities, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include clerodane diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
